description: This file provides service functions for managing notifications in a gym management system, including listing notifications, marking them as read, creating new notifications, and materializing scheduled reminders.

methods.name: list_for_user
methods.description: Lists notifications for a specific user with optional unread filter and pagination.

methods.name: mark_read
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read for a user.

methods.name: create_notification
methods.description: Creates a new notification entry, optionally marking it as sent if scheduled time is in the past.

methods.name: materialize_due_reminders
methods.description: Marks scheduled notifications as sent if their scheduled time has passed and they are not yet sent.
